about: Divisiones de capítulo revisadas contra el facsímil del testigo. El reconocimiento ABBYY no produjo el rótulo impreso de algunas planas (auditado: 286 rótulos en ABBYY y en DjVu XML, ninguno adicional aguas arriba), así que la única evidencia que queda es la imagen. Cada entrada es una transcripción del testigo, no una inferencia: ni la secuencia ni el canon pueden crear una entrada aquí.

visual_source.lineage: Declared source=original by the Internet Archive item; the 879 MB JP2 ZIP is a derivative of this PDF.
page_mapping_evidence: declared leaves in the DjVu XML: 652, with PARAM PAGE index == scan_page for every one (0 mismatches)
pages in the PDF: 652 (/Count 652) — no leaf added or dropped between the two derivatives

visual_source.page_mapping_basis: Structural, not an empirical offset. The DjVu XML declares every leaf's own index in PARAM name="PAGE" (…_0475.djvu), 0-based; those declared indices equal scan_page for all 652 leaves with no mismatch. The PDF holds the same 652 leaves numbered 1-based (/Count 652). Both derivatives therefore enumerate one identical leaf sequence, so pdf_page = scan_page + 1 holds everywhere rather than at the pages that happen to have been checked.

reviews.observed_context: Under it, the editorial argument «Elogio de Josué, de Caleb, y de los Jueces, hasta Samuel.», then verse 1 «Esforzado en la guerra fué Jesus, hijo de Nave». The running header of the same page reads «CAPITULO XLVI. 467».
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 105 dpi of pdf page 476, visual reading
reviews.rationale: The recognition did emit a line where the facsimile has the chapter label, but destroyed its numeral: block p0475l0032 reads «CAPÍTULO* XX vi», which no numeral reading can turn into a chapter number, so the division was detected with number=None and the chapter stayed unidentified. The facsimile shows XLVI plainly, in the label and again in the running header of the same page. This entry therefore supplies the numeral to a boundary that already existed; it does not insert a second heading. Sequence was not used: chapters 45 and 47 were already read directly from OCR, and this entry was written from the image.

reviews.observed_context: The running header reads «SALMO C XVIII.». The whole span is one psalm: the marks in the text are the acrostic stanza letters (HE. 33, VAU. 41, CAPH. 81, LAMED. 89), not chapter labels.
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 110 dpi of pdf pages 172 and 175, visual reading
reviews.rationale: The eleven-page gap between accepted headings (scan 168 to 179) is the largest in Psalms and was the top-ranked candidate. The facsimile shows no missing chapter: Vulgate Psalm 118 has 176 verses and legitimately runs across those pages. Recorded as a rejection so the gap heuristic is not re-run over it, and as a warning that page gaps are a weak signal in Psalms.

reviews.observed_context: Printed page number 575 in the top right corner. Under the label, the editorial argument «Habiendo venido unos embajadores del Rey de Babylonia á Ezechías, les muestra éste sus tesoros; é Isaías le vaticina que algun dia serian presa de los cháldeos.», then verse 1 in both columns: «In tempore illo misit Merodach» / «Por aquel tiempo Merodach Bala-».
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 150 dpi of pdf page 584, visual reading of the crop
reviews.rationale: The recognition emitted the label as «CAPÍTULO XXX'IX.»: an apostrophe broke XXXIX into two readable romans, 30 and 9, so the numeral was ambiguous and the chapter resolution left it unidentified. The facsimile shows XXXIX unbroken. Sequence was not used and could not have been: the numeral was read off the printed label in the facsimile. The canon's chapter count for the book plays no part in this entry.

reviews.observed_context: Under the label, the editorial argument «De los Reyes y de los vasallos. Se ha de hacer bien aun á los enemigos.», then verse 1 in both columns: «Hae quoque parabolae Salomonis, quas transtulerunt viri Ezechiae regis Juda.» / «Tambien son de Salomon estas parábolas siguientes, que copiaron los varones encargados de Ezechías, Rey de Judá.»
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 150 dpi of pdf page 260, visual reading of the crop
reviews.rationale: The recognition emitted the label as «CAPÍTULO XXY.», turning the final V into a Y and leaving two plausible romans, 20 and 25, so the chapter resolution left it unidentified. The facsimile shows XXV. The verse that follows it is the opening of Proverbs 25 in both columns, which is the source corroborating itself. Sequence was not used and could not have been: the numeral was read off the printed label in the facsimile. The canon's chapter count for the book plays no part in this entry.

reviews.observed_context: Running header «LIBRO DE LA SABIDURÍA» with printed page number 338. Above the label, chapter 13 ends at its verse 19; under it the editorial argument «Necedad y ceguera de los idólatras: descríbese el origen de la idolatría.», then verse 1 in both columns: «Iterum alius navigare cogitans» / «Asimismo piensa otro en navegar».
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 150 dpi of pdf page 347, visual reading of the crop
reviews.rationale: The recognition emitted the label as «CAPÍTULO XIV-», whose numeral reads cleanly, but nothing on the plate corroborated it -- the running header of this page carries the book name and the printed page number, not a chapter numeral -- so the chapter resolution refused to write an uncorroborated reading and left it unidentified. The facsimile confirms XIV directly, which is corroboration of a different kind than a second OCR guess. Sequence was not used and could not have been: the numeral was read off the printed label in the facsimile. The canon's chapter count for the book plays no part in this entry.

Daños de la melancolia, y bienes de la alegría del corazon.», then verse 1 in both columns: «Qui diligit filium suum, assiduat illi flagella» / «El que ama á su hijo, le hace sen-».
reviews.reviewer_method: pdftoppm render at 150 dpi of pdf page 436, visual reading of the crop
reviews.ocr_state: heading present, numeral trailed by noise
reviews.rationale: The recognition emitted the label as «CAPÍTULO XXX. ^ . t», dragging page speckle into the line so the numeral came out with 30 and 1 as candidates and the chapter resolution left it unidentified. The facsimile shows XXX followed by nothing but dirt on the plate. Sequence was not used and could not have been: the numeral was read off the printed label in the facsimile. The canon's chapter count for the book plays no part in this entry.
